name: Healthlead Public Company Limited
summary: Healthlead Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiaries, specializes in the creation, sourcing, and distribution of a wide array of health-related goods. This portfolio encompasses pharmaceuticals, medicinal preparations, beauty aids, nutritional supplements, and medical devices. Their offerings also include hygiene products like disinfectants and deodorizers, notably masks, sold under brand names such as iCare, Pharmax, vitaminclub, and Super Drug. Furthermore, nutritional supplements are marketed under the PRIME and Besuto brands. Diversifying its operations, the company engages in property leasing, event planning, restaurant management, and operates its own medical clinic. It maintains a retail footprint through 28 pharmacy locations: 11 iCare, 13 Pharmax, 3 vitaminclub, and 1 Super Drug. The company was founded in 2018 and has its principal office in Nonthaburi, Thailand.
